confirmedFindings.result: No normalized article-body text differences, outside-region article text, lost non-UI links, lost main IDs, or table row/cell-shape differences were detected.
confirmedFindings.limits: Text comparison exclusions and whitespace normalization are described in limitations. This is a source coverage check, not pixel-identical browser certification.

confirmedFindings.runtimeStatus: 已恢复：缩放仅限原站带 data-image-lightbox 的 3 幅图片（overview 2 幅、serialization 1 幅）。支持点击、Enter/空格、currentSrc/alt、关闭按钮、遮罩和 Escape；aria-label 随语言切换，关闭后清除预览 src/alt。正文与样例图按原有响应式／比例规则呈现。

confirmedFindings.explanation: These controls are outside retained article semantics. Original copy/lightbox/footer toolbars are intentionally removed and local site controls replace them. Raw counts must not be presented as missing prose.
No original body tabs, details, picture/source sets or media embeds were lost. The 22 published details/summary elements are added Mermaid source disclosures.

limitations: Text comparison excludes preformatted code, scripts/styles, SVG text, button/dialog/footer UI, heading-anchor accessibility text and API breadcrumbs; controls and source code are inventoried separately.
Whitespace is ignored for source text comparison. Raw outside-region segments and text differences are candidates requiring semantic classification, not automatically declared omissions.
历史载荷计数不包含前端运行时恢复的图标、布局包装和交互控件；最终呈现状态需结合已应用修复及最终浏览器报告。
